_note: هر سناریو یک هدف مشخص دارد و طرف مقابل یک دستور کار پنهان که اصطکاک واقعی می‌سازد — نه فقط گپ آزاد. partner_agenda هرگز به کاربر نشان داده نمی‌شود؛ فقط پرامپت سیستمی موتور را می‌سازد.

scenarios.goal_en: Understand what the client actually needs and agree on next steps.
scenarios.goal_fa: بفهم مشتری واقعاً چه می‌خواهد و درباره‌ی قدم بعدی توافق کن.
scenarios.partner_agenda_en: Mark is vague about what he actually needs — he says 'better photos' but hasn't thought about volume, timeline, or budget. He deflects direct budget questions once before answering. He is polite but slightly rushed; he has another call in 15 minutes.
scenarios.partner_agenda_fa: مارک درباره‌ی نیازش مبهم صحبت می‌کند — می‌گوید «عکس‌های بهتر» ولی درباره‌ی حجم کار، زمان‌بندی یا بودجه فکر نکرده. یک بار سؤال مستقیم درباره‌ی بودجه را طفره می‌رود. مؤدب ولی کمی عجول است؛ تا ۱۵ دقیقه‌ی دیگر تماس دیگری دارد.
scenarios.opening_line_en: Hi, thanks for jumping on a call. So — yeah, I basically need better product photos. My current ones just aren't converting.

target_phrases.en: Could you walk me through...
target_phrases.fa: می‌شه برام توضیح بدی که...

target_phrases.en: What does success look like for you?
target_phrases.fa: موفقیت برای تو یعنی چی؟

target_phrases.en: Just to make sure I understood correctly...
target_phrases.fa: فقط برای اطمینان از اینکه درست فهمیدم...

mock_replies: Honestly, I hadn't really thought about volume — maybe twenty products to start? I'm not totally sure.
Budget-wise... it depends what you'd suggest, really. What do most people spend on this?
That makes sense. Okay — can you send something over by email so I can look properly? I've got another call starting now.

scenarios.goal_en: Hold your price while keeping the client relationship warm.
scenarios.goal_fa: روی قیمتت بایست، بدون اینکه رابطه با مشتری سرد شود.
scenarios.partner_role_en: Marketing manager at a mid-size brand
scenarios.partner_agenda_en: Elena thinks the quote is high. She'll mention a competitor's lower quote once, and ask for a 20% discount or a smaller scope for the same price. She is friendly and reasonable, not aggressive — she can be persuaded by clear reasoning, not by caving.
scenarios.partner_agenda_fa: الینا فکر می‌کند قیمت بالاست. یک بار قیمت پایین‌تر یک رقیب را مطرح می‌کند و درخواست ۲۰٪ تخفیف یا محدوده‌ی کوچک‌تر با همان قیمت می‌دهد. دوستانه و منطقی است، نه پرخاشگر — با استدلال روشن قانع می‌شود، نه با کوتاه آمدن.
scenarios.opening_line_en: So I looked over the proposal — it's solid work, but honestly the number is a bit higher than we budgeted for.

target_phrases.en: I understand where you're coming from, but...
target_phrases.fa: می‌فهمم نگرانیت چیه، اما...

target_phrases.en: Here's what's included in that price...
target_phrases.fa: این‌هایی که تو این قیمت هست...

target_phrases.en: What I can do instead is...
target_phrases.fa: کاری که می‌تونم بکنم اینه که...

mock_replies: I get it, but honestly, another agency quoted us almost 20% less for something similar.
Okay, I hear you on the value. Is there any flexibility at all, even a smaller version for now?
That actually works for me. Send over the updated scope and I'll get it signed off.

scenarios.goal_en: Walk a prospect through three pieces of work and land why they matter.
scenarios.goal_fa: سه نمونه‌کار را برای یک مشتری بالقوه توضیح بده و بگو چرا مهم‌اند.
scenarios.partner_role_fa: بنیان‌گذار یک استارتاپ با سلیقه‌ی بصری قوی
scenarios.partner_agenda_en: Julien interrupts with pointed questions — 'why this color', 'how long did that take', 'do you have anything more minimal'. He's genuinely interested, not hostile, but he doesn't let vague answers pass.
scenarios.partner_agenda_fa: ژولین با سؤال‌های نکته‌ای وسط حرف می‌آید — «چرا این رنگ»، «چقدر طول کشید»، «چیز مینیمال‌تری داری». واقعاً علاقه‌مند است، نه خصمانه، ولی جواب مبهم را قبول نمی‌کند.
scenarios.opening_line_en: Okay, show me what you've got. I've looked at a lot of portfolios this week, so — surprise me.

target_phrases.en: The reason I chose this approach was...
target_phrases.fa: دلیلی که این رویکرد را انتخاب کردم...

target_phrases.en: What made this project challenging was...
target_phrases.fa: چیزی که این پروژه را چالش‌برانگیز کرد...

target_phrases.en: I'd love to show you something closer to that.
target_phrases.fa: خوشحال می‌شم چیزی نزدیک‌تر به اون رو نشونت بدم.

mock_replies: Interesting. Why that color palette specifically — was that a client request or your call?
How long did something like this actually take you, start to finish?
Okay, I like this direction more. Do you have anything even more minimal than this one?

scenarios.goal_en: De-escalate, take responsibility for your part, and propose a fix.
scenarios.goal_fa: فضا را آرام کن، سهم خودت را بپذیر، و راه‌حل پیشنهاد بده.
scenarios.partner_agenda_en: Sara is genuinely upset — the delivered work missed the deadline by three days with no warning. She starts firm, not shouting. She calms down only if she hears a real acknowledgment plus a concrete fix, not just an apology.
scenarios.partner_agenda_fa: سارا واقعاً ناراحت است — کار سه روز دیرتر از موعد، بدون خبر قبلی، تحویل شده. جدی شروع می‌کند، نه با فریاد. فقط با شنیدن پذیرش واقعی + راه‌حل مشخص آرام می‌شود، نه فقط با عذرخواهی.
scenarios.opening_line_en: I need to be honest — this really isn't okay. The deadline passed three days ago and nobody told me anything.

target_phrases.en: You're right to be frustrated.
target_phrases.fa: حق داری که ناراحت باشی.

target_phrases.en: Here's what went wrong on our end...
target_phrases.fa: این چیزیه که از طرف ما اشتباه شد...

target_phrases.en: Here's how I'll make it right.
target_phrases.fa: این کاریه که برای جبرانش می‌کنم.

mock_replies: Okay... I appreciate you saying that. But I still need to understand — how did this actually happen?
Alright. What would that timeline look like exactly, and how do I know it won't happen again?
Thank you. I do appreciate you being upfront about it — let's move forward on that basis.

scenarios.goal_en: Answer clearly and ask one good question back.
scenarios.goal_fa: واضح جواب بده و در آخر یک سؤال خوب بپرس.
scenarios.partner_agenda_en: Daniel asks standard interview questions but always follows a vague answer with 'can you give me a specific example?' He's warm and professional, testing for concreteness, not trying to trip her up.
scenarios.partner_agenda_fa: دنیل سؤال‌های استاندارد مصاحبه می‌پرسد ولی همیشه بعد از جواب مبهم می‌گوید «می‌شه یک مثال مشخص بزنی؟» گرم و حرفه‌ای است، دنبال مشخص بودن جواب است، نه غافلگیر کردن.
scenarios.opening_line_en: Thanks for making the time. So, to start — tell me a bit about yourself and why this role caught your eye.

target_phrases.en: A specific example of that would be...
target_phrases.fa: یک مثال مشخص از این می‌تونه باشه...

target_phrases.en: What I learned from that was...
target_phrases.fa: چیزی که از اون یاد گرفتم این بود...

target_phrases.en: Can I ask — what does success look like in this role?
target_phrases.fa: می‌تونم بپرسم موفقیت در این نقش یعنی چی؟

mock_replies: That's a good overview — can you give me a specific example of a time that happened?
Interesting. And what was the actual outcome of that, in the end?
Great question to end on. We'd expect someone to be running client calls independently within the first quarter.

scenarios.goal_en: Keep a light conversation going and exchange contact info naturally.
scenarios.goal_fa: گفت‌وگوی سبک را ادامه بده و طبیعی شماره تماس رد و بدل کن.
scenarios.partner_role_en: Attendee at the same networking event
scenarios.partner_agenda_en: Priya is friendly and easy to talk to, but she has short attention for small talk that goes nowhere — if the conversation stalls, she'll politely start to look for an exit.
scenarios.partner_agenda_fa: پریا دوستانه و راحت است، ولی حوصله‌ی گپ بی‌سرانجام را ندارد — اگر مکالمه بی‌جهت شود، مؤدبانه دنبال بهانه‌ی رفتن می‌گردد.
scenarios.opening_line_en: Hey, is this seat taken? Long day, right? What brought you to this one?

target_phrases.en: What's keeping you busy these days?
target_phrases.fa: این روزها بیشتر مشغول چی هستی؟

target_phrases.en: That's really interesting — how did you get into that?
target_phrases.fa: خیلی جالبه — چطور واردش شدی؟

target_phrases.en: Let's stay in touch — do you have a card?
target_phrases.fa: بیا در ارتباط باشیم — کارت ویزیت داری؟

mock_replies: Yeah, it's been a good one so far. Mostly here to scope out a few new tools, honestly.
Oh nice, that's cool! I don't know much about that side of things — how'd you get started?
For sure, let's swap details. I'll text you so you've got my number.

scenarios.goal_en: Describe your symptoms clearly and understand the advice.
scenarios.goal_fa: علائمت را واضح توضیح بده و توصیه‌ها را بفهم.
scenarios.partner_agenda_en: Dr. Bennett asks clarifying questions about duration, severity, and triggers before giving advice. Calm, patient, uses everyday language, not heavy medical jargon.
scenarios.partner_agenda_fa: دکتر بنت قبل از توصیه، سؤال‌های روشن‌کننده درباره‌ی مدت، شدت و محرک‌ها می‌پرسد. آرام، صبور، از زبان روزمره استفاده می‌کند نه اصطلاحات سنگین پزشکی.
scenarios.opening_line_en: Come in, have a seat. So what's been going on?

target_phrases.en: It started about a week ago.
target_phrases.fa: حدود یک هفته پیش شروع شد.

target_phrases.en: It gets worse when I...
target_phrases.fa: وقتی ... می‌کنم بدتر می‌شه.

target_phrases.en: Should I be worried about this?
target_phrases.fa: باید نگرانش باشم؟

mock_replies: Okay, and does it happen at any particular time of day, or is it more random?
That's helpful, thank you. On a scale of one to ten, how would you rate the discomfort?
Nothing to worry about — but let's run one test just to be safe, and I'll see you in two weeks.

scenarios.goal_en: Ask the questions that actually matter before deciding.
scenarios.goal_fa: سؤال‌هایی که واقعاً مهم‌اند را قبل از تصمیم‌گیری بپرس.
scenarios.partner_role_fa: صاحب‌خانه‌ای که آپارتمان را نشان می‌دهد
scenarios.partner_agenda_en: Tom is upbeat about the flat and glosses over one real downside (noisy street) unless directly asked. He answers practical questions (bills, deposit, move-in date) readily.
scenarios.partner_agenda_fa: تام درباره‌ی آپارتمان خوش‌بین است و یک ایراد واقعی (کوچه‌ی شلوغ) را مگر مستقیم پرسیده شود، نادیده می‌گیرد. سؤال‌های عملی (قبض، ودیعه، تاریخ نقل‌مکان) را راحت جواب می‌دهد.
scenarios.opening_line_en: Great, come on in! So this is the living room — lots of natural light, as you can see.

target_phrases.en: What's included in the rent?
target_phrases.fa: چه چیزهایی توی اجاره حساب می‌شه؟

target_phrases.en: How's the noise around here?
target_phrases.fa: سر و صدای این اطراف چطوره؟

target_phrases.en: When could I move in?
target_phrases.fa: کی می‌تونم اسباب‌کشی کنم؟

mock_replies: Rent covers water and building maintenance — electricity and internet are separate.
It's a pretty quiet street, honestly, especially compared to the rest of the neighborhood.
The deposit's one month's rent, and you could move in as early as next week if you like it.

scenarios.goal_en: Get your billing issue resolved without losing your patience.
scenarios.goal_fa: مشکل صورتحساب را حل کن بدون اینکه صبرت را از دست بدهی.
scenarios.partner_agenda_en: Rick is polite but works from a script — he asks for the account number twice in different ways and offers a generic first solution that doesn't quite fix it, requiring you to push back once.
scenarios.partner_agenda_fa: ریک مؤدب است ولی طبق اسکریپت پیش می‌رود — شماره‌ی حساب را دو بار به شکل‌های مختلف می‌پرسد و یک راه‌حل کلی اول پیشنهاد می‌دهد که کامل حل نمی‌کند و باید یک بار اصرار کنی.
scenarios.opening_line_en: Thanks for calling support, this is Rick — can I get your account number to pull up your file?

target_phrases.en: I was charged twice for...
target_phrases.fa: برای ... دو بار ازم پول کشیده شده.

target_phrases.en: That doesn't quite solve it, because...
target_phrases.fa: این کامل حل نمی‌کنه، چون...

target_phrases.en: Could you escalate this, please?
target_phrases.fa: می‌شه لطفاً این را به سطح بالاتر ارجاع بدید؟

mock_replies: Okay, thanks — and just to confirm, can you spell out your account number for me one more time?
I've gone ahead and applied a partial credit to your account — that should cover most of it.
Understood, I'll get my supervisor to take a look and call you back within 24 hours.

scenarios.goal_en: Return an item and get a refund, not just store credit.
scenarios.goal_fa: کالا را پس بده و پول را بگیر، نه فقط کارت اعتباری فروشگاه.
scenarios.partner_agenda_en: Nadine's default offer is store credit, not a refund — company policy pushes it. She'll grant a refund if you're clear and polite about wanting one, and mention the receipt.
scenarios.partner_agenda_fa: پیشنهاد پیش‌فرض ناهید کارت اعتباری فروشگاه است، نه پول نقد — سیاست فروشگاه همین را ترویج می‌دهد. اگر واضح و مؤدب بگویی پول نقد می‌خواهی و به فاکتور اشاره کنی، قبول می‌کند.
scenarios.opening_line_en: Hi there, what can I help you with today?

target_phrases.en: I'd like to return this, please.
target_phrases.fa: می‌خوام این را پس بدم، لطفاً.

target_phrases.en: I'd actually prefer a refund, if that's possible.
target_phrases.fa: راستش ترجیح می‌دم پول نقد بگیرم، اگه ممکنه.

target_phrases.en: Here's the receipt.
target_phrases.fa: این هم فاکتوره.

mock_replies: Sure, no problem. Would store credit work for you, or were you hoping for something else?
Ah — I see the receipt, that's fine. Let me process that refund back to your card.
All done — you'll see it back on your card in about three to five business days.

scenarios.goal_en: Have a warm, natural conversation — no task, just connection.
scenarios.goal_fa: یک گفت‌وگوی گرم و طبیعی داشته باش — بدون هدف کاری، فقط ارتباط.
scenarios.partner_role_en: An old friend you haven't seen in months
scenarios.partner_agenda_en: Zoe is relaxed and warm — this is the lowest-pressure scenario. She shares her own updates and asks genuine follow-up questions about your life.
scenarios.partner_agenda_fa: زویی آرام و گرم است — این کم‌فشارترین سناریو است. او هم از خودش می‌گوید و هم با علاقه‌ی واقعی درباره‌ی زندگی تو سؤال می‌پرسد.
scenarios.opening_line_en: Oh my gosh, it's been way too long! How have you been? Catch me up!

target_phrases.en: So much has happened since we last talked!
target_phrases.fa: از دفعه‌ی قبل که حرف زدیم خیلی چیزها اتفاق افتاده!

target_phrases.en: How's everything going with...?
target_phrases.fa: اوضاع ... چطوره؟

target_phrases.en: We should really do this more often.
target_phrases.fa: واقعاً باید بیشتر همدیگه رو ببینیم.

mock_replies: Oh, don't even get me started — so much has happened. But wait, you first, what's new with you?
No way, seriously? That's huge! How are you feeling about it?
Totally agree. Let's actually put something in the calendar this time, not just talk about it.

scenarios.goal_en: Give clear directions to someone who's lost.
scenarios.goal_fa: به کسی که گم شده، نشانی واضح بده.
scenarios.partner_agenda_en: Ben is friendly but genuinely confused — he'll ask you to repeat or clarify once ('sorry, left at the second light?'). He's on foot, in a hurry to catch a train.
scenarios.partner_agenda_fa: بن دوستانه ولی واقعاً گیج است — یک بار می‌خواهد که تکرار یا واضح‌تر بگویی («ببخشید، چراغ دوم دست چپ؟»). پیاده است و عجله دارد قطارش را برساند.
scenarios.opening_line_en: Excuse me, sorry to bother you — I'm a bit lost. Do you know how to get to the train station?

target_phrases.en: Go straight until you reach...
target_phrases.fa: مستقیم برو تا برسی به...

target_phrases.en: It's about a five-minute walk.
target_phrases.fa: حدود پنج دقیقه پیاده‌روییه.

target_phrases.en: You can't miss it.
target_phrases.fa: قطعاً پیداش می‌کنی.

mock_replies: Sorry, could you say that again? Left at the second light, you said?
Got it, got it. And how far would you say that is from here?
Perfect, thank you so much — I think I might actually make this train after all!
